title: Flowchart-Image Jailbreaks Without Training: Auditing Open VLMs

original_idea.body: Concealed-jailbreak detector transfer (extends JBShield arXiv:2602.19396): fit an activation-disentanglement probe per attack family, evaluate cross-family detection AUROC as a transfer heatmap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-family detector transfer addresses false-security from in-distribution-only evaluation; concrete chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation probe + 4-family transfer matrix on one model; building attack families adds effort but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused transfer heatmap; assembling four attack families is a moderate workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public weights, forward-pass-only, lab-deprioritized robustness question; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Forward passes + light probe; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-attack-family transfer rarely measured; likely mostly novel.
